hook: The stolen safe was downstairs. Jason and Lucia were still trapped above it, arguing over the empty shaft.
script: The stolen safe was downstairs. Jason and Lucia were still trapped above it, arguing over the empty shaft. Six minutes earlier, they entered a hotel to recover their passports before the building changed owners. Lucia found the safe beside a freight lift. Beside its call button, somebody had scratched a ladder. Jason loaded the safe. The platform dropped, leaving them facing a locked stairwell and approaching security lights. He grabbed a chair to smash through. Lucia caught his wrist. Broken glass would announce their floor. She followed the scratched symbol to a maintenance hatch. Behind it, a fixed service ladder descended. Jason climbed first. Lucia followed, reaching the grounded platform just as security unlocked the upstairs stairwell. She opened their safe and pocketed both passports. Next job, she said, you ride with the luggage.
